modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Air Albania includes 8 kg of hand luggage (23x40x55 cm) in the ticket price.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Hand baggage up to 23 x 40 x 55 cm (length + width + depth no more than 118 cm), for child and adult passengers.

carryon_weight.value: 8 kg of hand luggage is included in the ticket price.

size_weight.value: On all flights a single piece of checked baggage can weigh up to 32 kg; heavier pieces are not accepted and must be split into 2. Maximum checked bag dimensions (length + width + depth) are 158 cm.

infant_allowance.value: Infants are entitled to a piece of baggage weighing 10 kg, plus 1 foldable stroller up to 115 cm carried as checked baggage. Children get the same allowance as adults.

excess_baggage_fees.value: Baggage over the free allowance is charged as extra baggage: 10 EUR per kg for Italy and Turkey (last minute) destinations; EUR 6 per kg for United Kingdom and Germany destinations.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Air Albania's General Conditions of Carriage set out what it does when it cancels or delays a flight.

rebooking.value: If Air Albania cancels or delays a flight, cannot provide confirmed space or makes you miss a connection, it will either carry you on another of its flights with space, or reroute you to your ticketed destination on its own or another carrier's service or by ground transport, with no additional fare charged.

refund.value: Alternatively it refunds the ticket: the full fare paid if no portion has been used; if part has been used, the higher of the one-way fare from the point of interruption or the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the transportation used.

complaints.value: Complaints about flight delays, cancellations, denied boarding or baggage go to customer.care@airalbania.com.al; a reply is sent by e-mail within 6 weeks.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
